## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe clearly what the problem or limitation is.

Example: "I often need to check multiple URLs at once but the current interface only supports one at a time."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like. Be as specific as possible — what would the feature look like from the user's perspective? How would they interact with it?

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered and why they are insufficient.

## Scope

Which part of the application does this affect?

- [ ] Client (frontend)
- [ ] Server (backend)
- [ ] Authentication
- [ ] URL Scanner
- [ ] Email Scanner
- [ ] SMS Scanner
- [ ] QR Scanner
- [ ] OCR Scanner
- [ ] AI Explain
- [ ] Analytics
- [ ] History
- [ ] Settings
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: ___________

## Additional Context

Mockups, diagrams, links to similar implementations in other tools, or any other context that supports the request.
